description: Carrier Global Corporation is a global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, focused on providing differentiated, digitally enabled lifecycle solutions to its customers. Its portfolio includes industry-leading brands such as Carrier, Viessmann, Toshiba, Automated Logic and Carrier Transicold, which offer innovative heating, cooling and cold chain solutions, and it also provides a broad array of related building services, including audit, design, installation, system integration, repair, maintenance and monitoring. Its performance-driven culture is intended to create long-term shareowner value by investing strategically to strengthen its product position in homes, buildings and across the cold chain to drive profitable growth, and it believes its business segments are well positioned to benefit from favorable secular trends, including urbanization, population growth and demographic shifts, food security and safety, and electrification.
